Most screenshots contain text that was never meant to be copied:
labels in a dialog, a slide in a meeting, a frame of a video.
Reading it back should take one keystroke, not five minutes.

A good result keeps the paragraphs the way the author wrote them,
joins the lines inside each paragraph, and leaves code alone.

When the text is in another language, the translation should
appear right next to the original, ready to copy or pin.
